proofs.text: Retag the proof `@manual` and build the brief; verify the test entry names no file and its findings are exactly `manual`

reasons: PROOF-9 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: A `@manual` proof carries a note where a test would be and no test file, because its evidence is the approver's own

tests.body:
def test_a_manual_proof_has_a_note_where_a_test_would_be(self):
        made = Project(spec=SPEC.replace(
            'verify 200 and a token @integration',
            'verify 200 and a token @manual'))
        try:
            test = build(made, 'RULE-1')['tests'][0]
            assert test['file'] is None
            assert test['findings'] == ['manual']
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_manual_proof_has_a_note_where_a_test_would_be
